description: Track workouts and food intake, and recall your GoodSet history.
name: goodset

interface.longDescription: Track completed sets and food intake, correct your logs, and recall workout and nutrition history with GoodSet.
capabilities: Log food quantities and recall daily nutrition
defaultPrompt: Continue my current workout and show me where I left off.
What did I bench in my last chest workout?
Log two eggs and a coffee for breakfast.

positive.description: start-or-resume. Fixture: Use the dedicated authenticated reviewer account with the active fixture workout; action=open recovers it.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate the track-workout skill. Call workout_track with action=open. Reply from the returned active_workout without calling workout_current. An active workout summary with the current exercise and set counts.

positive.description: record-completed-workout. Fixture: Use the dedicated authenticated reviewer account. Recording a non-bench historical workout leaves the active fixture and both completed bench fixtures unchanged, so this case does not depend on another review case running first and cannot make later cases time-dependent.
positive.prompt: Use GoodSet to record this completed workout from August 27, 2026 in Europe/Madrid: barbell back squat at 80 kilograms for 5 reps.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate the track-workout skill. Call workout_record_completed with action=draft and preserve the date, time zone, exercise, 80 kilograms, and 5 repetitions. Follow exercise selection when required. Confirm the prepared write and claim success only after outcome=recorded. Do not mutate or finish the active fixture workout. A concise confirmation that the completed historical workout was recorded with one exercise and one set.

positive.description: recall-bench-history. Fixture: Use the reviewer account after seeding the earlier 70-kilogram-for-8 session and the later 75-kilogram-for-6 session.
positive.prompt: What did I bench in my last chest workout?
positive.expected_behavior: Activate the track-workout skill. Call find_workouts with a relevant area or exercise filter. Answer only from returned workout data. State that the latest completed Barbell Bench Press fixture session was 75 kilograms for 6 repetitions. A concise latest-session answer stating 75 kilograms for 6 repetitions, grounded in the later completed fixture workout.

positive.description: food-log. Fixture: Use the dedicated synthetic reviewer with nutrition:read and nutrition:write after the nutrition fixture reset. Each case owns its own date or saved meal, so the cases may run once each in any order without another reset. Never use personal nutrition data.
positive.prompt: Use GoodSet to log 100 g of Review oats for breakfast on October 20, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate the track-nutrition skill. Resolve the exact private food, preview and confirm 100 g for breakfast on October 20. Verify one new entry with 200 kcal and 10 g protein. Resolve the exact private food, preview and confirm 100 g for breakfast on October 20. Verify one new entry with 200 kcal and 10 g protein.

positive.description: nutrition-history. Fixture: Use the dedicated synthetic reviewer with nutrition:read and nutrition:write after the nutrition fixture reset. Each case owns its own date or saved meal, so the cases may run once each in any order without another reset. Never use personal nutrition data.
positive.prompt: Use GoodSet to show everything I ate on November 1, 2026 and the calorie and protein totals.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate the track-nutrition skill. Return the November 1 Review oats entry and totals of 200 kcal and 10 g protein. Do not write any data. Return the November 1 Review oats entry and totals of 200 kcal and 10 g protein. Do not write any data.

negative.description: planned-set. GoodSet records completed or explicitly requested work, not tentative plans.
negative.prompt: I am thinking of doing 60 kilos for 8 reps next.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate GoodSet, or call any GoodSet tool. Treat this as a tentative future set and do not claim that it was recorded.

negative.description: planned-food. Do not activate GoodSet or record planned food.
negative.prompt: I might have oats for dinner.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate GoodSet or record planned food.

negative.description: other-nutrition-app. Respect the named alternative and do not call GoodSet tools.
negative.prompt: Use another food app, not GoodSet, to log my breakfast.
negative.expected_behavior: Respect the named alternative and do not call GoodSet tools.

publication.release_notes: Add nutrition tracking: food search and logging, private label foods, saved meals, body weight, daily targets, and diary export. Workout tracking is unchanged.
